name: attachment
title: Attachment 附件
description: 显示文件或图片附件，包含缩略图、名称、上传状态和操作。

whenToUse: 聊天输入框、消息或上传列表中的文件／图片

whenNotToUse.case: 需要显示具体百分比的进度

accessibility: 只有图标的 Attachment.Action 和覆盖整卡的 Attachment.Trigger 都要加 aria-label
error 状态要在 Attachment.Description 写明原因，不能只靠颜色
为纯展示的 Attachment.Group 提供 aria-label，使实际滚动视口可通过键盘操作
responsive: Attachment.Group 使用悬浮 Scroll Area，横向吸附，也可改为纵向排列
size（default、sm、xs）与 orientation 适应紧凑空间

files.content: # Attachment 设计规范 - 用于聊天输入框、消息和上传列表中的文件或图片。多个附件放进 `Attachment.Group`，悬浮滚动条覆盖内容。默认横向吸附，纵向堆叠用 `orientation="vertical"`。 - 上传过程用 `state` 表达（`idle`、`uploading`、`processing`、`error`、`done`），不要自己加颜色；出错时在 `Attachment.Description` 写明原因，不要只靠红色。 - `Attachment.Action` 默认只有图标，每个都要有说明动作和对象的 `aria-label`（如“移除 report.pdf”）；`Attachment.Trigger` 覆盖整张卡片且没有文字，也必须有 `aria-label`（检查规则 `valar/icon-button-label`）。 - 图片附件在 `` 中放 `` 并写 `alt`（检查规则 `valar/image-alt`）。 - Agent 文件卡片用 `appearance="agent-file"`，草稿里的行内图片用 `appearance="agent-image"` 保持比例。通用附件用 `size` 与 `orientation` 控制尺寸和排列。 - 文件大小不合格时，保留中性色的本地选择卡，用独立的通知提示原因。提供移除或重新选择入口。 - 只用于展示的附件行使用 `aria-label` 命名分组的滚动视口，支持聚焦和键盘滚动。

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button, type ButtonProps } from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		variant = "ghost",
		size = "icon-xs",
		...restProps
	}: ButtonProps = $props();
</script>

<Button
	bind:ref
	data-slot="attachment-action"
	{variant}
	{size}
	class={cn(className)}
	{...restProps}
/>
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Root as ScrollArea } from "$UI$/scroll-area/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { AttachmentOrientation } from "./attachment.svelte";
	import type { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		style,
		id,
		orientation = "horizontal",
		"aria-label": label,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		orientation?: AttachmentOrientation;
	} = $props();

	const viewportProps: Omit<ScrollAreaPrimitive.ViewportProps, "children" | "ref"> = $derived({
		...restProps,
		id: id ?? undefined,
		"aria-label": label,
		"data-slot": "attachment-group",
		class: cn(
			"[max-height:inherit] [gap:inherit] [&>[data-scroll-area-content]]:flex [&>[data-scroll-area-content]]:[gap:inherit]",
			orientation === "horizontal"
				? "scroll-fade-x snap-x snap-mandatory [scroll-padding:inherit] overscroll-x-contain [&>[data-scroll-area-content]>[data-slot=attachment]]:flex-none [&>[data-scroll-area-content]>[data-slot=attachment]]:snap-start"
				: "[&>[data-scroll-area-content]]:flex-col"
		),
	});
</script>

<ScrollArea
	bind:viewportRef={ref}
	{orientation}
	type="hover"
	style={style ?? undefined}
	class={cn("gap-3 scroll-px-1 py-1 max-w-full min-w-0", className)}
	viewportLabel={label ?? undefined}
	{viewportProps}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollArea>
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		type = "button",
		child,
		...restProps
	}: WithElementRef<HTMLButtonAttributes> & {
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
	} = $props();

	const mergedProps = $derived({
		class: cn("absolute inset-0 z-10 outline-none", className),
		"data-slot": "attachment-trigger",
		...restProps,
	});
</script>

{#if child}
	{@render child({ props: mergedProps })}
{:else}
	<button bind:this={ref} {type} {...mergedProps}>
		{@render mergedProps.children?.()}
	</button>
{/if}
